WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS max_purchase_date,
    (CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months')::DATE AS start_purchase_date
  FROM orders o
),
payments_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS order_total
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
)
SELECT
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date,
  ABS(AVG(pp.order_total))::numeric AS average_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN payments_per_order pp ON o.order_id = pp.order_id
JOIN params p ON 1=1
WHERE
  CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= p.start_purchase_date
  AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= p.max_purchase_date
GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
ORDER BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) ASC;
